items.name: NCSU Wolfpack Fall 2026

venue.name: North Carolina State University Talley Student Union
venue.details: Piedmont + Mountains Ballroom on the third level (one floor up from main level entrances)

items.information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCSUWolfpackFall2026#69863-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCSUWolfpackFall2026#69868-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

Additionally, this competition has been made possible with the help of CubePack, the cubing club at NC State! All NC State students who are official members of CubePack on Get Involved will receive refunded registration. You must pay up front and will be refunded after the competition.

items.name: Rockland Rounds 2026

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

items.information:
This is a series competition with [Rockland Rookies 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RocklandRookies2026). Please note that you may only register for and compete at one of the two.

The Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.
